\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-04},
  title = {The model covers used passenger cars only},
  note = {\textbf{Absorbs EDN-24} (2026-09-29): the pre-registered exclusion stays although its flag is one-sided.},
  date = {2026-09-22},
  milestone = {M1: Project Inception},
  topic = {Problem Specification},
  participants = {@lukas2510},
  decision = {The model covers used passenger cars: \texttt{offer\_\allowbreak{}type =\allowbreak{} U}, not pre-registered, \texttt{vehicle\_\allowbreak{}type =\allowbreak{} Car}.
The pipeline filters out new cars, pre-registered cars, and transporters, and the API rejects them.
\texttt{is\_\allowbreak{}preregistered} defines the scope and is therefore not a feature.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Keep everything, with the flags as features: more data, but one model would learn two price mechanisms, list prices and the second-hand market.
\item Detect unmarked pre-registered cars with a heuristic: there is no ground truth to validate it, so it would drop ordinary used cars.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} An exploratory LightGBM run showed almost no accuracy difference between the two scopes, so product clarity decides: a used-car price component prices used cars.
Known limit: a \texttt{False} in \texttt{is\_\allowbreak{}preregistered} can mean ``not stated'' (EDN-23), so some unmarked pre-registered listings remain in the training data.},
  ai = {Information seeking, Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI profiled the data, ran the comparison on both scopes, and recommended this scope.
Lukas checked that the numbers came from the real dataset.
AI later found that its own proposal to use \texttt{is\_\allowbreak{}preregistered} as a feature contradicted this entry, and withdrew it.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code sessions of 2026-09-22 (issue \#2) and 2026-09-29 (issue \#25).},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/problem-spec.md}{Problem specification} section 2, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/2}{issue \#2}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/pull/17}{PR \#17}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/25}{issue \#25}.},
